aggregation_notes.T_task: Mean task completion time over successful scenarios only.
aggregation_notes.d_min_global: Global minimum clearance over all evaluated scenarios.
aggregation_notes.t_c: Mean planning cycle time over all planning cycles.
aggregation_notes.t95: 95th percentile of planning cycle time over all planning cycles.
aggregation_notes.Omega_bar: Mean credible joint scenario set size over all planning cycles.
aggregation_notes.C_Omega: Mean per-scenario true joint intent coverage by credible joint sets.
aggregation_notes.URR: Mean unrecoverable shared-plan ratio over all planning cycles: 1 - recoverable_shared_plan_count / shared_plan_count.
